newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-Show widening bias.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-Show widening bias.

text.p: A modestly weaker and thinly traded Australian bond market saw yield spreads to other dollar bloc debt show a widening bias.

An early contraction against Canada was also slowly being unwound after the Canadian federal budget announcement, and Canadian analysts anticipate a modest rally there later today, even though there were no surprises in the statement.

The local market showed a muted response to an unexpectedly high 6.0 percent rise in January merchadise imports given that a large proportion of the increase was related to capital imports and confirmed expectations of strong capital investment in ther coming months, economists said.
Trade in domestic debt was subdued ahead of the key January CPI report later today, an event that also kept the U.S. Treasury market in a narrow range in both New York and Tokyo.
Meanwhile, New Zealand bonds struggled higher in equally dull trading.
